Setup wizard in the console: numbered steps with visible progress, step 3 of 10, and a back button on every screen
Wizard step: company name, logo upload and web address
Wizard step: the first administrator, who becomes the Super Admin
Wizard step: staff source, choosing between Google Workspace, Microsoft, Lark or a spreadsheet, signing in and pulling the list
Wizard step: AI provider, either their own key or a local-only profile with no external provider
Wizard step: optional data source connections, skippable and repeatable later from the console
Wizard step: review everything before any of it is written, because a wizard that commits each screen as it goes cannot be corrected
The wizard becomes unreachable the moment the first administrator exists, so the install path cannot be replayed by anybody who finds the address
A resumable install: closing the browser halfway continues where it stopped rather than starting the server again
Every step validates before it advances and says what is wrong in words the person can act on
A finishing screen that hands the person straight into the console already signed in, with nothing further to configure before the system answers a question
Installer output legible to a person: what it is doing, how far through it is, and what to do if a step fails
